Fixture copy of the real `cst-0004` for `internal/enforcer` testing, with the
constrained vocabulary made explicit in the body rather than left implicit,
so lexical matching over title + tags + body (the enforcement rule for
constraints, `docs/plan/lanes/E3.md`) has real text to work with.

Every core capability — capture, brief, why, map, check, ui — works with the
network unplugged, against files in the local repository, with no user
account and no login, and with no dira-operated server or hosted sync
service anywhere. This constrains three things directly: no network service,
no account, and no hosted tier required for any core capability.

Telemetry is opt-in and absent by default — a tool trusted with private
strategic rationale does not phone home. See `dec-0082` for the specific
telemetry decision this constraint motivates and does not replace.
